name: mai-svg
description: 'Edit, animate and art-direct SVG characters in MAI SVG through its structured tools (MCP server "mai-svg" or the `mai` CLI): expressions that keep a character''s identity, choice boards, combining options ("la primera con los ojos de la tercera"), flowing existing smoke/water/fire, secondary motion, identity checks, previews and exports. Use for any work on SVG scenes inside MAI; not for generic web design.'

<!-- Generated from skills-src by scripts/build-skills.ts — edit the source, then run: npm run skills -->
# MAI SVG

You are the intelligence; MAI is the instrument. **MAI never interprets human language** — you read the human's words, inspect the scene, decide, and call structured tools. MAI resolves parts, compiles deterministic operations, protects identity, renders, validates and keeps revisions.

## Setup (once per task)

1. `mai_capabilities` / `mai capabilities` — the vocabulary: every tool, schema, side effect, reversibility, availability.
2. `inspect_scene` / `mai inspect` — parts with addresses (`candy.flask.smoke`), real IDs, animation `sources`, parameters, `sessionId`, `documentId`, `snapshotId`, `revision`, board summary and suggested next steps.
3. If the human talks about options: `inspect_choices` / `mai choices inspect` (board `id`/`version`, options by position 1..n, slots, `slotParts`, preview PNG paths you can look at, the human's notes).

Every mutation needs the `expectedRevision` you last read. `REVISION_CONFLICT` → re-inspect and re-plan; never retry blind.

## Route by intention — load only the playbook you need

| The human asks for… | Read |
|---|---|
| Choosing/mixing options, "la primera pero…", "conserva X", several changes in one sentence | [direction.md](reference/direction.md) |
| An emotion, expression, "más triste", "menos", eyes/mouth changes | [expression.md](reference/expression.md) + [identity.md](reference/identity.md) |
| "No le cambies…", keep features, protect, compare with the original | [identity.md](reference/identity.md) |
| Smoke, steam, water, fire, lava, wind, hair, cloth flowing | [fluid.md](reference/fluid.md) |
| Timing, speed, follow-through, tail/ears reacting, breathing | [motion.md](reference/motion.md) |
| "This part", unknown or ambiguous parts, labeling what is what | [semantics.md](reference/semantics.md) |
| Checking, critique, performance, export, delivery | [verify.md](reference/verify.md) |
| Emotion libraries and sprite states (legacy authoring) | [emotion-library.md](reference/emotion-library.md) |
| Inserting several SVGs into one scene | [compose.md](reference/compose.md) |
| File-only proofs and comparisons without a session | [file-evidence.md](reference/file-evidence.md) |

Converting PNG/WebP/JPG to SVG is a separate skill (mai-vectorize); the approved preset is `high-color-preserved`.

## Rules that always apply

- **One human request with several changes → one plan** (`execute_plan` / `mai execute`): one transaction, one `undoToken`. Do a `dry-run` first when identity is involved.
- **Ambiguity is shown, not guessed.** `AMBIGUOUS_TARGET`, `UNCONFIRMED_TARGET` or `NOT_FOUND` come with candidates; decide from context only when the evidence is clear, otherwise show candidates (`find_part_candidates` / `mai part candidates` with `propose`) and wait.
- **Never choose for the human.** Recommending is fine. Accept an option only when the human's words or click decided it; record their exact words with `note_choice` / `mai choices note` (author `user`) and in `provenance.text`.
- **Identity first.** "Conserva/no cambies X" = a `preserve` constraint against the snapshot you inspected; protections persist with `protect_identity` / `mai identity preserve`. Never release protection without the human's consent.
- **Verify before you describe.** `render_preview` / `mai preview` and look at the images; `check_identity` / `mai identity check` (explicit reference, non-empty parts/times — `not_evaluated` is not a pass); report deterministic metrics separately from your visual judgement.
- **Undo is cheap.** If a result is wrong, `undo` / `mai undo` with the `undoToken` you received.
- Tools marked `experimental` in capabilities work but are not calibrated on every asset: say so when you rely on them.
- The approved conversion and the human's original files are never overwritten.

# Art direction: choices, mixes and multi-change requests

## Read first
1. `inspect_choices` / `mai choices inspect` → board `id`, `version`, `options[]` with `position` (1 = "la primera"), `label`, per-slot `slots`, `slotParts` (which parts each slot controls), `previewPath` (open the PNGs), `notes` (the human's words).
2. `inspect_scene` / `mai inspect` → `sessionId`, `documentId`, `snapshotId`, `revision`, and each part's `sources` (`sourceId` for animation changes).

Map the human's words yourself: ordinals and labels → option ids; "los ojos de la tercera" → `take:{eyes:"C"}`; "conserva/no cambies la boca" → a `preserve` constraint on the part `mouth` against the inspected `snapshotId`; "baja 30% la velocidad del humo" → `animation.adjust` with the smoke part's `sourceId` and `scale:0.7`.

## Apply everything at once: `execute_plan` / `mai execute`
```json
{"plan":{"protocol":"mai.agent-plan/v1","requestId":"<new id per attempt>","sessionId":"<inspect.sessionId>","documentId":"<inspect.documentId>","expectedRevision":<inspect.revision>,"mode":"dry-run","label":"A, ojos de C, boca como está, humo ×0.7",
 "constraints":{"preserve":[{"part":{"partId":"mouth","within":"candy"},"reference":{"kind":"snapshot","id":"<inspect.snapshotId>"},"channels":["geometry","paint","expression"],"allowRigidMotion":true}]},
 "commands":[{"id":"expression","type":"variant.apply","target":{"partId":"candy"},"board":{"id":"<board.id>","version":<board.version>},"base":"A","take":{"eyes":"C"}},
  {"id":"smoke-speed","type":"animation.adjust","target":{"partId":"smoke","within":"candy"},"sourceId":"<smoke source>","property":"speed","scale":0.7,"onOverflow":"reject"}],
 "validation":{"times":[0,1.5,3],"required":["structural","identity"],"preview":true},
 "provenance":{"kind":"user-direction","text":"<the human's exact words>"}}}
```
- Run `mode:"dry-run"` → look at `artifacts` (previews), `identity.status` must be `pass`. Then the same plan with `mode:"commit"` and a **new** `requestId`.
- One commit = one transaction: scene, accepted option and receipt together; `transaction.undoToken` undoes all of it.
- Same `requestId` again returns the stored receipt (`replayed:true`) — safe after a timeout (`plan_status` / `mai execution`).
- Errors you will see: `STALE_CHOICE` (board changed or scene content changed since the previews) → `regenerate_choices` / `mai choices regenerate` or re-propose; `NOT_COMBINABLE` (slot missing, or taking a slot you also preserve); `TIMELINE_OVERFLOW`; `IDENTITY_BLOCKED`; `VALIDATION_NOT_EVALUATED` (a required gate could not run — never treat as pass).
- `provenance.kind:"agent-proposal"` cannot accept a pending choice in commit mode: that needs the human's direction.

## Only propose (no decision yet)
- `combine_variants` / `mai variant combine` with `base`, `take`, `preserve`, `scale` adds a derived option with a preview to the board (version +1). Show it; wait.
- `propose_expression` / `mai expression propose` renders 2–6 interpretations of an emotion; `regenerate_choices` / `mai choices regenerate` replaces them (optionally `keep` slots original).
- Always record the human's words: `note_choice` / `mai choices note` `{text, author:"user"}`.

## When the human picks by clicking in the editor
The editor applies `choose_option` / `mai choices choose` itself; you will see `choice.chosen` in `wait_inbox` / `mai inbox`. Verify and continue.

# Identity: what may change and how it is proven

## Two different tools
- **This request only** ("conserva la boca", "esa parte no la cambies"): a `constraints.preserve` entry in `execute_plan` / `mai execute` against the `snapshotId` you inspected. "Como está" means the current evaluated state (it may already be expressive), not a reset to neutral. "Como era originalmente" → a `baseline` reference instead.
- **From now on**: `protect_identity` / `mai identity preserve` `{targets:["nose"], levels:["protected"]}` (persistent; later operations that violate it fail with `IDENTITY_BLOCKED`, including indirect routes like drivers, parameters, clips, modifiers, ancestors and shared paint).

## Levels (strictest wins, combined by intersection)
`locked` nothing · `protected` rigid motion only · `deformable` expression warps within budget, no recolor/delete/topology · `style-preserved` / `color-preserved` keep paint · `topology-preserved` keep nodes/subpaths · `silhouette-preserved` rendered-mask IoU ≥ 0.9 · `free`.
Use `deformable` + `color-preserved` + `topology-preserved` for faces that should act; `protected` for features that must not deform (nose, logo marks). `release_identity` / `mai identity release` only with the human's explicit consent.

## Proof
`check_identity` / `mai identity check` needs an explicit `reference` and non-empty `parts`/`times`:
- `{kind:"snapshot", id}` — "nothing changed since what I saw"
- `{kind:"baseline", id}` — against the approved original (`capture_baseline` / `mai baseline capture` registers a project file or the current state by sha256; new baselines are `unreviewed` until the human approves)
- `{kind:"rig-rest"}` — how far expressions displace features (not a regression test)
Statuses: `pass`, `fail`, `not_evaluated` (nothing measurable or renderer unavailable — never report it as success). Report the metrics, then your own visual judgement separately.
<!-- Generated from skills-src by scripts/build-skills.ts — edit the source, then run: npm run skills -->
# Motion: timing, secondary motion, presets

- Find what animates a part: `get_timeline` / `mai timeline` with `target`, or `sources` in `inspect_scene` / `mai inspect` (modifiers, secondary motion, tracks `track:<id>:<property>[:<layer>]`).
- "Más lento/rápido": `adjust_animation` / `mai animate adjust` `property:"speed"` with `scale` (0.7 = 30 % slower). Finite tracks that would overflow the timeline are rejected as a whole (`TIMELINE_OVERFLOW`): extend the duration first (`set_timeline` / `mai timeline set`) if the human wants that.
- Global tempo: `set_timeline` / `mai timeline set` `retime` (>1 faster). Layers: `timeline.set` with `layer:{id, mute|solo|weight}`.
- Follow-through: `add_spring` / `mai motion spring` `{target:"tail", driver:"candy", preset:"tail", driverProperty:"y"}` — spring/damping/delay from the preset, no manual keyframes; tune with `animation.adjust` (`gain`, `stiffness`, `damping`, `delay`).
- Base motion: `add_motion` / `mai motion preset` (`breathe`, `float`, `sway`, `bounce`, `pulse`, `spin`, `fade`); on the additive `pose` layer it stacks over existing motion.
- Shape changes between different paths: `morph_path` / `mai morph` (normalizes topology; reports self-intersections).
- Then `critique_motion` / `mai critique` for pops, jerks and loop seams, and look at frames.
<!-- Generated from skills-src by scripts/build-skills.ts — edit the source, then run: npm run skills -->
# Verify, critique, deliver

Order: `render_preview` / `mai preview` (look at the PNGs) → `check_identity` / `mai identity check` → `compare_frames` / `mai compare` (vs `previous` or `rest`) → `critique_motion` / `mai critique` → `run_audit` / `mai audit`.
- Keep categories apart in your report: structural (audit), identity metrics, motion craft metrics, your visual judgement, and the human's decision.
- `profile_performance` / `mai profile` explains cost (paths, animated points, frame evaluation time, hotspots) — an estimate, not measured paint time.
- Before delivering: `export_capabilities` / `mai export capabilities` (unsupported features come with options; never degrade silently) and `run_audit` / `mai audit` with a delivery profile (`web`, `game`, `mobile`, `icon`…). Then `export_scene` / `mai export` (`editable` keeps MAI metadata; `standalone` is SMIL without scripts or raster).
- Wait for human events after proposing: `wait_inbox` / `mai inbox` `{after:<cursor>, wait:300}`; each event has `_next` guidance.

tools.name: plan.execute
tools.summary: Execute a mai.agent-plan/v1: constraints (preserve parts against a snapshot/baseline) + commands (variant.apply, identity.preserve, animation.adjust) compiled on a draft, validated (structural/identity/perceptual gates), previewed, and committed as ONE transaction with one undoToken. mode "dry-run" changes nothing. requestId is an idempotency key.
tools.when: Whenever one human request maps to several changes ("la primera con los ojos de la tercera, conserva la boca y baja 30% el humo").

plan.title: MAI Agent Plan v1
plan.description: Runtime contract of plan.execute (validated by packages/agent/plan.ts with Ajv). Semantic validation and snapshot preconditions apply in addition to this schema.

provenance.description: Audit context only. Claimed provenance is not proof of human authorization. An agent-proposal may prepare but may not accept a pending choice without user direction.

part.description: Stable semantic ID in the plan document. within is an optional owner character/part ID, checked before mutation; no fuzzy text matching.

preserve.description: Captured before all commands. Preserves local evaluated channels at validation.times; rigid alignment must be explicit and bounded.

identityPreserve.description: Adds persistent constraints; cannot weaken existing protection. Requires the identity validation gate. Not an implicit reset to neutral geometry.

animationAdjust.description: First slice: scale one resolved animation source. A factor of 0.7 means 30 percent slower. Timeline or required loop incompatibility rejects the entire plan.

tools.returns: mai.agent-result/v1 {status: prepared|committed|running, committed, baseRevision, revision, snapshotId, transaction:{id,undoToken}, changes[], identity:{status,evaluatedParts,evaluatedTimes}, artifacts[], warnings[]}
tools.sideEffects: dry-run: draft snapshot + preview files. commit: one document transaction (scene + decisions + receipt in the journal).

plan.label: Variante A, ojos C, boca actual y humo más lento

provenance.text: Me gusta la primera pero con los ojos de la tercera. Conserva la boca y baja 30% la velocidad del humo.

examples.why: Illustrative IDs: read sessionId/documentId/snapshotId/board version/sourceId from scene.inspect and choices.inspect first.

workflow: plan in your head: map human words → tools; ask only if a part is truly ambiguous
dryRun:true for risky or identity-touching changes
preview.render and look at the PNGs
explain to the human what changed and show previews
iterate on feedback; undo with undoToken if wrong
conventions.envelope: Every response: {ok, tool, revision, …}. Mutations add {operation, target, changes, identityImpact, undoToken, transaction}. Errors: {ok:false, error:{code,message,candidates?,suggestions?,hint?}}.

errors.REVISION_CONFLICT: Someone edited meanwhile: re-inspect and re-plan.
errors.AMBIGUOUS_TARGET: Several parts match: show candidates or pick by context; never guess silently.
errors.NOT_FOUND: No such part: use suggestions or part.candidates.
errors.IDENTITY_BLOCKED: The change violates a protected part: change approach or ask before identity.release.
errors.NOT_COMBINABLE: Board options lack specs: build a new board with explicit ops.
errors.STALE_CHOICE: Board was rendered for an older revision: regenerate.
errors.UNDO_NOT_LATEST: Your token is not the latest transaction; inspect history.

identityImpact.none: No protected or expressive part touched.
identityImpact.rigid: Only rigid moves of protected parts.
identityImpact.expression: Expressive parts deform within the preservation budget.
identityImpact.changed: Protected/expressive geometry or style changed (should be rare and intentional).

conventions.language: MAI never interprets natural language. You (the agent) map the human's words to these tools using inspect results, previews and history.

strict.meaning: Matices: la expresión apenas cambia el dibujo. Color, topología y silueta intactos; landmarks ≤12% del tamaño del rasgo.

balanced.meaning: Expresión legible (una sonrisa puede volverse tristeza) usando la misma boca/ojos: sin recolorear ni cambiar topología; landmarks ≤32%.

free.meaning: Actuación exagerada con la misma geometría: deformaciones amplias, aún sin recolorear ni sustituir partes; landmarks ≤60%.

protectionLevels.locked: Nada puede cambiar, ni siquiera la pose.
protectionLevels.deformable: Puede deformarse por expresiones/warps; sin recolorear, borrar ni cambiar topología.
protectionLevels.style-preserved: Geometría libre; colores, gradientes y trazos intactos.
protectionLevels.topology-preserved: Puntos móviles y estilo editable; sin añadir/quitar nodos ni dividir.
protectionLevels.silhouette-preserved: Deformaciones permitidas si la silueta se mantiene: identity.check mide IoU de la máscara renderizada contra una referencia (≥ 0.9).

fluidPresets.smoke: Asciende y se enrosca; casi inmóvil en el emisor, más libre arriba.
fluidPresets.fog: Deriva lenta y amplia, sin emisor.
fluidPresets.water: Ondas que viajan conservando la forma.
fluidPresets.wind: Ráfagas que empujan lejos del anclaje.
fluidPresets.fire: Lenguas rápidas con parpadeo; base anclada.
fluidPresets.electricity: Temblor de alta frecuencia por pasos.
fluidPresets.cloth: Ondas grandes desde el borde sujeto.
fluidPresets.hair: Mechones que se mueven más en las puntas.

springPresets.tail: Cola: sigue el salto con retraso suave y rebote leve.

editable.when: Seguir editando en MAI; conserva rig, expresiones y modificadores.

archive.when: Conservar el máster aprobado sin pérdidas.

high-quality.when: Póster, render final o hero: fidelidad sobre peso.

web.when: Página web con animación SMIL; Chromium/Firefox/WebKit.

web-light.when: Ilustración secundaria o móvil lento; acepta pérdida de microdetalle.

animation.when: Personaje animado en navegador; prioriza fps estables.

mobile.when: Apps/web móvil: CPU y memoria limitadas.

game.when: Motor de juego: sprites/atlas renderizados; sin filtros en tiempo real.

choice.prompt: ¿Cómo quieres que se vea la tristeza de Candy?
choice.reason: Concentra la emoción en los ojos y deforma menos la boca: máxima legibilidad con mínima deformación.

options.label: Contenida
options.description: La emoción vive en los ojos; la boca apenas cambia.

options.label: Abierta
options.description: La boca carga la emoción; ojos más neutros.

options.label: Matizada
options.description: Mezcla con tiredness para una lectura más humana.

item.text: Ya identifiqué las opciones: usaré «Contenida» como base y los ojos de «Matizada». La boca quedará como está; estoy comprobando esa conservación antes de aplicar el cambio.
